title: Resonance — Emergent Agency
description: Entry point to the self-experience series: a set of prototypes for feeling out how a sense of agency comes into being through interaction.

title: Choudo Ii Watashi
description: A self-experience prototype exploring the felt balance of agency, comfort, and subjective fit.

title: Yokeru Watashi
description: An experiential app for observing avoidance, timing, and the sense of an acting self.

title: KAMAE ARTS
description: A creative prototype for exploring kamae through interaction, attention, and aesthetic experience.

title: Reaction Test
description: A lightweight browser experiment for observing reaction time, readiness, and the timing of action.

title: Heat & Energy Balance Checker
description: A practical prototype that connects bodily sensation, heat, energy saving, and everyday decision-making.

title: Indoor Drying Odor Risk Checker
description: A daily-life checker that turns subjective discomfort and environmental conditions into a simple reflective tool.

title: 交替勤務カレンダーメーカー
description: A trial version that shows workdays and days off for this month and next month from a shift pattern and reference date. Interface in Japanese.

title: 灯油の日数・灯油代計算機
description: A trial version that estimates how long kerosene will last and its cost from fuel consumption, hours of use, and fuel price. Interface in Japanese.

title: ふたりの休み合わせカレンダー
description: A trial version that finds shared days off from two people's work schedules. Interface in Japanese.

title: タッチうんどうかい
description: A demo of a two-player game with three events, played face to face on one smartphone. Interface in Japanese.

title: ごろごろフルーツ
description: A demo of a greengrocer puzzle: merge matching fruits, grow them, and fill customers' orders. Interface in Japanese.

title: 有給の付与日・日数 計算機
description: A trial version that estimates paid leave dates and days from a start date, working days, and working hours. Interface in Japanese.

title: 派遣の3年ルール いつまで計算機
description: A trial version that estimates dates related to a temporary work assignment from its start date and other details. Interface in Japanese.

title: 年末年始の連休 計算機
description: A trial version that finds consecutive days off around New Year from company holidays and available paid leave days. Interface in Japanese.
